**6B.5 Research Note: Joe Biden in 2024**

Bottom line: **mostly yes.** The best 2024 evidence shows Biden’s team using measurement, professional staff, public process, and explicit corrective action in major service-delivery areas like education, Medicare drug pricing, housing, disability access, and disaster response. The strongest counterevidence is narrower: some policies were framed for electoral benefit, and reporting suggests an insular inner circle that could filter bad news. I did **not** find strong direct evidence that social-service delivery itself was run in a systematically anti-evidence way.

| Assessment | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | The Better FAFSA: What Students and Their Families Need to Know | U.S. Department of Education | 2024-02-16 | https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/paying-college/better-fafsa-what-students-and-their-families-need-know | ED says it modernized FAFSA, expanded Pell access, and made aid easier to reach for students and families. That is direct evidence of using process reform to improve service delivery. | 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3 |
| Positive | March 26, 2024 letter on additional steps to support students, families, and institutions during the transition to the Better FAFSA | U.S. Department of Education | 2024-03-26 | https://www.ed.gov/laws-and-policy/education-policy/key-policy-letters-signed-by-the-education-secretary-or-deputy-secretary/03262024-Better-FAFSA | The department describes deploying federal personnel, technical assistance, and process fixes after rollout problems. This is explicit transparent correction, not just a policy announcement. | 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3 |
| Positive | Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program: Negotiated Prices for Initial Price Applicability Year 2026 | CMS | 2024-08-01 | https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/fact-sheets/medicare-drug-price-negotiation-program-negotiated-prices-initial-price-applicability-year-2026 | CMS laid out a structured negotiation process with public input and patient-focused listening sessions. That is strong evidence of evidence-based program management. | 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3 |
| Positive | Negotiating Lower Drug Prices Works, Saves Billions | CMS | 2024-08-15 | https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/press-releases/negotiating-lower-drug-prices-works-saves-billions | CMS says negotiated drug prices will save Medicare billions and lower out-of-pocket costs for millions of beneficiaries. This shows measured correction of a documented cost problem. | 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3 |
| Positive | US Department of Labor announces framework to help employers promote inclusive hiring as AI-powered recruitment tools’ use grows | U.S. Department of Labor | 2024-09-24 | https://www.dol.gov/newsroom/releases/odep/odep20240924 | DOL’s disability-employment office issued a framework to reduce accessibility barriers for disabled job seekers. This is evidence of professional, feedback-oriented service governance. | 6B.5, 6B.3 |
| Positive | Biden-Harris Administration Announces Next Funding Round of $504 Million for 12 Tech Hubs Across America | U.S. Department of Commerce | 2024-07-02 | https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/07/biden-harris-administration-announces-next-funding-round-504-million-12 | Commerce says the program uses competitive selection and directs benefits to rural, Tribal, industrial, and disadvantaged communities. That supports a rules-based, non-patronage allocation model. | 6B.5, 6B.3, 5B.8 |
| Positive | Joint Statement of Janet L. Yellen, Secretary of the Treasury, and Shalanda D. Young, Director of the Office of Management and Budget, on Budget Results for Fiscal Year 2024 | U.S. Department of the Treasury | 2024-10-18 | https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy2657 | Treasury and OMB framed policy around jobs, lower costs, middle-class growth, housing, child care, health care, and prescription drugs. This is evidence of metric-driven governance rather than ad hoc patronage. | 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3, 6B.4 |
| Positive | Professor Matthew Kraft Appointed to White House Council of Economic Advisers | Brown University | 2024-07-24 | https://www.brown.edu/news/2024-07-24/matthew-kraft | Brown says Biden appointed an academic economist to the CEA to provide objective evidence and real-time analysis. That is direct evidence of relying on competent professionals. | 6B.5, 6B.4 |
| Positive | FACT SHEET: Biden-Harris Administration Approves Nearly $2 Billion for Hurricane Response… | The American Presidency Project / White House | 2024-10-16 | https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/fact-sheet-biden-harris-administration-approves-nearly-2-billion-for-hurricane-response | The response prioritized temporary housing, food, water, emergency supplies, debris removal, and infrastructure restoration. This is concrete service-delivery correction in a crisis. | 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3 |
| Mixed / Negative | Biden seeks to cancel some interest on student loans, aiding 23 million Americans | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-04-08 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/biden-seeks-to-cancel-some-interest-on-student-loans-aiding-23-million-americans-3368853 | Reuters says the policy had real affordability benefits, but the White House also framed it around support from young voters. That weakens a pure evidence-first reading. | 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3 |
| Mixed / Negative | AP roundup on student-loan forgiveness | Associated Press | 2024-02-26 | https://apnews.com/article/8a751e085839df0b19c0a599169002cf | AP reports critics argued the relief skewed toward college and higher-income borrowers and shifted costs onto nonborrowers. That is counterevidence for neutral, broadly calibrated service design. | 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3 |
| Mixed / Negative | Biden's new danger: The calls are coming from inside the house | Axios | 2024-07-11 | https://www.axios.com/2024/07/11/biden-leaks-inner-circle-polling | Axios reports aides were filtering information and shielding Biden from bad news. That is indirect but relevant counterevidence for transparent correction. | 6B.5, 6B.4 |
| Mixed / Negative | Scoop: Inside Biden's shrinking inner circle | Axios | 2024-07-12 | https://www.axios.com/2024/07/12/biden-election-inner-circle-withdrawal-criticism | Axios describes a smaller, more insular inner circle that avoids conflict and filters what reaches the president. This cuts against a fully open evidence-and-correction environment. | 6B.5, 6B.4 |
| Mixed / Negative | Biden's loyal inner circle, family influence, scripted communications | Associated Press | 2024-07-09 | https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/chaos-swirling-since-bidens-debate-flub-is-causing-cracks-in-a-white-house-known-for-discipline/ | AP describes a disciplined but highly loyal circle with family influence and scripted communications. That is negative context for transparent feedback loops, though it is not direct proof of service-delivery patronage. | 6B.5, 6B.4 |

**Search gap**

- Strongest positive evidence is in Education, CMS, Treasury/OMB, DOL, Commerce, and the White House disaster response, where sources explicitly describe process fixes, competitive selection, public input, and measurable outcomes.
- Strongest negatives are **indirect**: an insular White House/campaign information environment and electoral framing of some benefits. I did **not** find strong direct evidence that social-service agencies in 2024 ignored measurement or systematically resisted correction.
- I also did not find much direct evidence of independent third-party audits of day-to-day social-service delivery during 2024; the record is strongest on official process announcements and program corrections.
